name: R063-chansey-metronome-transform-ends-disable
why: Challenge 1. The player's Chansey 227 plays Defense Curl (slot 2) once, then Metronome (slot 0) 12 turns; the foe is Wigglytuff 207 (Sing, Disable, Wish, Secret Power). A Disable on the Defense Curl slot (Disable takes the last move used, battle_script_commands.c:4407) and then a Metronome call of Transform replace the disabled slot: the Disable ends silently (battle_util.c:1700). Chance per seed about 0.3%.
